source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Renders the time interval and home idiom while recording the house alternative in a note.
key_decisions.before: When Jesus returned to Capernaum after some days, word spread that he was at home.
key_decisions.after: A few days later, Jesus returned to Capernaum, and word spread that he was at home.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when he returned to Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains their faith and the passive forgiveness declaration.
key_decisions.before: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, “Child, your sins are forgiven.”
key_decisions.after: Seeing their faith, Jesus said to the paralyzed man, “Child, your sins are forgiven.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Child, your sins are forgiven.”

key_decisions.rationale: Chooses Levi as the house’s owner with the pronoun ambiguity recorded in a note.
key_decisions.before: Later, as Jesus was reclining at the table in Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with Jesus and his disciples, because many of them were following him.
key_decisions.after: As Jesus reclined at the table in Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners ate with him and his disciples, for many were following him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And it happened that he was reclining at table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners were reclining with Jesus and his disciples, for many were following him.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the doctor analogy and omits to-repentance absent from this source.
key_decisions.before: Jesus heard them and said, “Those who are healthy do not need a physician, but those who are sick do. I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
key_decisions.after: Jesus heard this and said, “Healthy people do not need a doctor; sick people do. I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And hearing, Jesus said to them, “Those who are strong have no need of a physician, but those who are ill. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.”

key_decisions.rationale: Renders sons-of-the-wedding-chamber idiom naturally and retains the repetition.
key_decisions.before: Jesus said to them, “Can the wedding guests fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
key_decisions.after: Jesus answered, “Can the wedding guests fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And Jesus said to them, “Can the sons of the wedding chamber fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves walking and plucking without adding an explicit eating verb absent here.
key_decisions.before: One Sabbath Jesus was passing through the grainfields, and his disciples began making their way while plucking heads of grain.
key_decisions.after: One Sabbath Jesus was passing through grainfields. As his disciples made their way along, they began plucking heads of grain.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And it happened that he was passing through grainfields on the Sabbath, and his disciples began to make a path, plucking heads of grain.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Abiathar rather than silently reconciling the name with Samuel.
key_decisions.before: He entered the house of God in the time of Abiathar the high priest and ate the bread of the Presence, which no one except the priests is permitted to eat, and he also gave some to those who were with him.”
key_decisions.after: He entered God’s house in the time of Abiathar the high priest and ate the bread of the Presence, which only priests may lawfully eat. He also gave some to those with him.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: how he entered the house of God in the time of Abiathar the high priest and ate the bread of the Presence, which it is not lawful for any to eat except the priests, and also gave it to those with him?”
